$comment: CODEOWNERS-gated registry of scenarios/classes that must never be quarantined (C-REL-23). The file is committed at specs/010-headless-verification-runner/never-quarantine.json. Automation may never add, remove, or weaken an entry; every change requires maintainer review. 'classes' is a CLOSED set: minItems and maxItems both equal the enum length so exactly the full set is required, and any addition is a schema major bump. A matching scenario is never a quarantine candidate; deterministic 100%-failing scenarios are regressions to bisect, and security/integrity failures are never quarantinable or demotable.
title: Living Roots Never-Quarantine Registry
description: Machine-readable closed set of failure classes and critical-path scenarios that are never eligible for quarantine. Draft 2020-12, strict objects, immutable versioned $id.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Registry payload version. v1 is the first published version and is immutable.

classes.title: Never-quarantinable failure classes
classes.description: Closed set. Exactly all ten classes must be present. A matching run is a regression or security/integrity event, never flake.

criticalPathScenarios.title: Critical-path scenarios
criticalPathScenarios.description: Every scenario tagged criticalPath: true in its scenario definition. These are never quarantinable regardless of flake history.

examples.reason: Save/load round-trip is a critical-path coverage class.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last reviewed change.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: CODEOWNERS handle accountable for the registry.

neverQuarantineClass.title: Never-quarantinable class
neverQuarantineClass.description: Closed vocabulary. host-guard-breach, version-mismatch, missing-dependency, threshold-violation, crash, and incomplete-signals (the partial verdict class) come from C-REL-23; integrity-failure and security-failure cover FR-024/FR-025; deterministic-regression covers deterministic 100%-failing scenarios; claim-overreach covers honesty/claim violations (policy, exit 21).

scenarioId.title: Scenario identifier
scenarioId.description: Stable kebab-case scenario identifier, matching scenario.schema.json.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this scenario is critical-path; advisory but strongly recommended.
